title: 第2574章 吸血鬼姐妹花第2573章 埋入矿脉
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
丘凌风目光看去，这两人赫然是出现在合照里的那两个外国姐妹花。
德古拉以及古娜莎。
姐姐德古拉，外表看起来大约二十岁出头，一袭血红色礼裙将傲人的身材凸显的淋漓尽致，长发微卷，五官精致立体，眼眸呈现出一抹暗红色，粉紫色的嘴唇还带着一丝若有若无的勾人弧度。
妹妹古娜莎，看起来只有十四五岁的模样，穿着血色公主裙，身材倒是没有姐姐德古拉那么吸引人，但也小有规模，白皙肌肤像是能发光一般，眼眸呈现出黑红色，浅紫色的嘴唇还微微抿着。
不得不说，这对姐妹花的颜值都不低，而且浑身上下都有一种说不出来的魅惑味道。
「目标：德古拉」
「体质：吸血鬼」
「修为：道灵第五境」
「……」
「目标：古娜莎」
「体质：吸血鬼」
「修为：道灵第二境」
「……」
“你小子艳福不浅啊~~”
丘凌风看着这对姐妹花，拍了拍千星阁阁主的肩膀，调侃道。
“你就别拿我打趣了。”
千星阁阁主有些哭笑不得的说道，“你知道她们两个为什么会成为我的奴隶吗？”
“你不是说她们两个是吸血鬼古堡怕得罪你赔给你的么？”
丘凌风挠了挠头，他只知道这一点。
对于更详细的内情，确实是一概不知。

“古娜莎曾经想把我同化成吸血鬼，成为她的血仆，结果我的皮太厚太硬，她的獠牙不仅没有刺穿我的血肉，还卡住了她的獠牙，意外的把她獠牙给拔了。”
“当时的我就气的大闹了吸血鬼古堡的驻地，德古拉想要阻止我，也被我一并打晕了，大闹了吸血鬼古堡驻地一通后，我气消的也差不多了，就没想继续追究。”
“然后因为古娜莎失去了獠牙，在吸血鬼古堡内部也没有了地位，加上德古拉和我交过手，吸血鬼古堡也把德古拉的獠牙拔了，一起送过来给我当奴隶，想要得到我的原谅。”
千星阁阁主提起往事，语气也不免唏嘘起来。
“凌风先生，这位是您的朋友么？”
德古拉抬起头来，观察起了丘凌风，然后她就感觉自己有些移不开目光了。
不知为何她出于吸血鬼本能，总想要靠近丘凌风。
在此之前，会让她生出本能反应的人有且只有一个，那就是千星阁阁主。
毕竟如果不是出于本能吸引，她的妹妹古娜莎当初也不会闯祸去同化千星阁阁主了。
结果偷鸡不成蚀把米。
把自己这位姐姐也搭了进来，一起成为了千星阁阁主的奴隶。
这时，古娜莎的目光也落在了丘凌风身上，然后她也和德古拉一样，舍不得挪开眼睛了。
看到这对姐妹花的反应，丘凌风愣了一下，然后就反应过来。
她们两个是被自己的苍龙精血给吸引了。
身具苍龙神体的丘凌风，一身血液都被淬炼成了苍龙精血，每一滴蕴含着恐怖的能量。
“咳，你们两个一直盯着洛雪可不礼貌。”
千星阁阁主轻咳一声，提醒道。
他自然是注意到了姐妹花的奇怪反应。
“实在抱歉，洛雪先生。”
“洛雪先生的气息太过于特殊，对于我们吸血鬼来说，实在是容易沉沦其中。”

古娜莎和德古拉脸上同时出现一抹羞红，姐姐德古拉倒是还能够冷静下来，一本正经的解释了起来。
content_en:
Qiu Lingfeng looked around and saw that these two people were the two foreign sisters who appeared in the group photo.
Dracula and Gunasha.
The elder sister, Dracula, looks to be in her early twenties. She wears a blood-red dress that highlights her proud figure. Her long hair is slightly curly, her facial features are exquisite and three-dimensional, her eyes are a touch of dark red, and her pink-purple lips have a hint of seductive arc.
The younger sister Gunasha looks like she is only fourteen or fifteen years old. She is wearing a blood-red princess dress. Her figure is not as attractive as her older sister Dracula, but she is still small in size. Her fair skin seems to be luminous, her eyes are black and red, and her light purple lips are slightly pursed.
I have to say that these two sisters are very good-looking, and they have an indescribable charm about them.
"Target: Dracula"
"Physique: Vampire"
"Cultivation: The fifth realm of Taoism"
"..."
"Target: Gunasha"
"Physique: Vampire"
"Cultivation: The Second Realm of Taoism"
"..."
"Your boy is so handsome~~"
Qiu Lingfeng looked at the sisters, patted the master of Qianxing Pavilion on the shoulder, and joked.
"Stop making fun of me."
The master of Qianxing Pavilion said with a bit of laughter, "Do you know why the two of them became my slaves?"
"Didn't you say that the two of them were paid to you by the vampire castle for fear of offending you?"
Qiu Lingfeng scratched his head, he only knew this.
I really don’t know anything about the more detailed inside story.
"Gunasha once wanted to assimilate me into a vampire and become her blood servant. As a result, my skin was too thick and hard. Her fangs not only failed to pierce my flesh and blood, but also got stuck, and her fangs were accidentally pulled out."
"At that time, I was so angry that I made a fuss at the Vampire Castle. Dracula tried to stop me, but I also knocked him unconscious. After making a fuss at the Vampire Castle, my anger was almost gone, and I didn't want to pursue it further."
"Then because Gunasha lost her fangs, she lost her status within the Vampire Castle. In addition, Dracula and I fought against each other. The Vampire Castle also pulled out Dracula's fangs and sent them to me as a slave, hoping to get my forgiveness."
The master of Qianxing Pavilion couldn't help but sigh when he mentioned the past.
"Mr. Lingfeng, is this your friend?"
Dracula raised her head and observed Qiu Lingfeng, and then she felt that she couldn't take her eyes away.
For some reason, she always wanted to get close to Qiu Lingfeng out of vampire instinct.
Before that, there was only one person who would give her an instinctive reaction, and that was the Pavilion Master of Qianxing Pavilion.
After all, if it weren't for instinctive attraction, her sister Gunasha wouldn't have gone into trouble to assimilate the master of Qianxing Pavilion.
As a result, stealing the chicken will end up losing the rice.
He brought his sister in and together they became the slave of the master of Qianxing Pavilion.
At this time, Nasha Guna's eyes also fell on Qiu Lingfeng, and like Dracula, she was reluctant to move her eyes away.
Seeing the reaction of the sisters, Qiu Lingfeng was stunned for a moment, and then came to his senses.
The two of them were attracted by their own Azure Dragon Essence and Blood.
Qiu Lingfeng, who possesses the Canglong divine body, has all his blood tempered into Canglong essence and blood, and every drop contains terrifying energy.
"Ahem, it's not polite for you two to keep staring at Luo Xue."
The master of Qianxing Pavilion coughed lightly and reminded.
Naturally, he noticed the strange reactions of the sisters.
"I'm so sorry, Mr. Luo Xue."
"Mr. Luo Xue's aura is too special. For us vampires, it is really easy to fall into it."
A blush appeared on the faces of Gunasha and Dracula at the same time, but her sister Dracula was able to calm down and explained seriously.
